findings.title: Canonical master board size
findings.detail: data/master.json carries 369 rows across 20 sports; its own counts block reports 369 rows total and 364 in scope.

findings.title: Canonical board is not today's board
findings.detail: 210 of 369 rows in data/master.json are dated before 24 Oct 2026 and 250 are dated on or before today; only 119 rows describe a future fixture. The file is regenerated by tools/build_master.py from the historical build files, so it will keep republishing yesterday's slate until those builds are re-run.

findings.title: Rows with no source link
findings.detail: 39 of 369 canonical rows (11%) carry no source_url at all. Example: M0001 — Aussie Rules — No fixture v No fixture.

findings.title: No canonical row leans on an aggregator or tipster site
findings.detail: 0 of 330 sourced canonical rows point at an OLBG page, a betting aggregator or a tipster site instead of a league/tour/federation page. Every sourced row cites a league, tour, federation or club body.

findings.title: Canonical predictions: length and wording
findings.detail: 73 rows carry prediction text; 0 are shorter than 30 words, 0 have no source link, and 35 use wording the brief forbids ("model", "verified").

findings.title: Repetition between published predictions
findings.detail: The most similar pair of prediction texts in the six most recently published desks scores 0.49 (1.00 = identical) in session-edffdbc6: Besiktas Istanbul @ Virtus Bologna ↔ Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade @ Zalgiris Kaunas. Under 0.55 is what this desk requires of its own output.

findings.title: High-confidence picks with no published price
findings.detail: 34 High picks in recent desks carry no fair price or probability. Example: session-edffdbc6 — None.

findings.title: Sports coverage in the canonical board
findings.detail: Row counts by sport: Basketball 95, Ice Hockey 74, Rugby Union 30, Tennis 28, Handball 22, Darts 20, Volleyball 19, Cricket 17, Snooker 17, Rugby League 10, Baseball 7, Golf 6, Greyhounds 6, Gaelic Football 5, Table Tennis 3, Badminton 3, Esports 2, Greyhound Racing 2, Motor Racing 2, Aussie Rules 1.

findings.title: Broken internal links on published pages
findings.detail: 0 dead internal links found across 31 root pages.

findings.title: This desk: priced rows carry an official link
findings.detail: 11 of 11 priced rows on this desk cite the official source they were built from; every unpriced row states why.
